key_finding: Layered IoT-digital twin-generative AI architecture with a hybrid BN-SE-PO model (Bayesian network, stacked encoder, Puma optimizer) for anomaly detection and decision suggestions; a claimed digital-twin simulation of a CNC machining cell reports OEE 65->82%, cycle time -25%, defects -50%, but the twin, data and validation are undocumented.
